question: Calculate \((\sqrt{5}+\sqrt{2})(\sqrt{5}-\sqrt{2})+(\sqrt{3}-1)^2\).
solution: Difference of squares: \((\sqrt{5})^2-(\sqrt{2})^2=3\); square of a binomial: \((\sqrt{3}-1)^2=3-2\sqrt{3}+1=4-2\sqrt{3}\). Adding gives \(7-2\sqrt{3}\).
